character.clothing: blocky uniform: flat-topped cap with a small square badge, dark torso with a lighter square chest panel, pale square hands, dark trousers, small dark shoes
character.faceAbstraction: minimal pixel face — two dark rectangular eyes and a tiny lighter mouth block, no nose, no outlines
character.poseLanguage: static upright idle stance, arms straight at sides, feet together; posed like a sprite seen from the side/three-quarter front
character.proportions: chibi stubby, roughly 1.6 heads tall, wide rectangular torso, tiny legs, big flat square head
character.silhouette: compact rectangular stack: flat cap → square head → box torso → two short legs, reads as one solid axis-aligned block

composition.background: flat banded wall and sky filling the top of the frame, horizontal strata
composition.characterScale: character ~1/4 of frame height, standing on the lower ground band
composition.density: sparse — few large shapes, wide empty flat bands between them
composition.foreground: empty striped ground band at the very bottom, no props
composition.midground: character standing on the platform band, props (door-sized frame, hanging panel, small signs, street lamp) mounted flat on the wall band behind
composition.objectScale: props are large flat rectangles, some near character height, arranged along a single horizontal line

constraints: 所有形状必须是轴对齐矩形、直角梯形或等腰三角形，禁止圆角、曲线与斜线
禁止描边、渐变、投影、贴图噪点；每个面只用一块纯色平涂
光源方向固定：所有受光面统一朝上/朝前，暗面统一压在同一侧
角色与道具都用同一套方形积木比例，不增加细节密度
悬空物体必须用一条极细的竖直挂绳连到上方横梁，不允许真正漂浮
背景按水平色带分层，层与层之间是硬边直切
保留高饱和的暖金/亮黄重音色用于发光物与目标物，不要把所有颜色都压成灰调

environment.architecture: flat brown wall band with a large framed panel, a small hanging panel, three small wall signs and a thin pole lamp — all mounted coplanar on the wall
environment.props: rectangular poster frame, hanging square panel, small color swatch signs, thin pole lamp with a round head
environment.terrain: horizontal banded ground: dark platform strip, a stripe of regularly spaced square blocks, then flat gray road bands
environment.textureDensity: very low — no texture at all, only flat color bands and hard-edged shapes

lighting.contrast: medium, mostly flat with a few dark/light pairings
lighting.direction: ambient front-top, no cast shadows on the ground plane
lighting.softness: hard-edged, zero falloff; color changes happen only at shape boundaries

glow_accent.appearance: solid opaque bright shape, reads as emissive without blur

metal_dark.appearance: flat matte dark metal, no specular

shapeLanguage: axis-aligned rectangles as the atomic unit
straight-edged trapezoids and isosceles triangles for roof/hill silhouettes
long horizontal bands stacking in flat strata
no rounded corners, no beziers, no diagonals except the triangle slopes
shapes overlap by butt-joining flush edges, never by soft blending

identity: muted earth palette with one warm gold accent

camera.framing: 横版单屏，地面占下三分之一

composition.layout: 水平色带分层，角色居中偏下
composition.scale: 角色约画面高四分之一，道具与角色同量级

constraints: 只使用轴对齐矩形、直角三角形/等腰三角形与直角梯形
禁止渐变、描边、投影与纹理
悬空物必须以细竖线连接上方结构
